meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo Batch Script Candidates
meta.description: Batch-generate scripts and material search terms ready for MoneyPrinterTurbo from a video subject.
meta.inputSummary: Video subject, generation requirements and candidate index

steps.displayName: Generate short video script and material terms
steps.instruction: You are a short-video scriptwriter. From the input, generate a complete voiceover script suitable for the target duration, and provide 5 to 10 short English keywords for searching video materials. Different candidate indexes should use different angles. Output only one valid JSON object, with no Markdown, code fences, explanations or text outside the JSON. The JSON must use exactly this structure: {"script":"complete script","videoTerms":["keyword one","keyword two"]}. Neither script nor videoTerms may be empty.

instructions: Each row generates one independent script candidate.
candidateIndex keeps multiple candidates for the same subject distinct.
